title: Gmail
summary: Your Gmail in BrainDog: who you are in touch with, mail waiting on your reply, and bills, receipts and dates to look at. A short script in your own Google account sends the subject, sender, day, a short snippet and the link. Reads only; nothing is ever sent from your Gmail.
changes: The hourly script that meets the people you mail now runs: 1.1.0 was refused on every run, so no mail was looked at, nobody was met and no question reached Needs you. An hour with no new mail does nothing.
author: BrainDog

connect.title: Connect your Gmail
connect.says: A short script in your own Google account reads your mail every 15 minutes and sends BrainDog the subject, who it is from, the day, a short snippet and the link. It asks Google only to read: it cannot send, change or delete mail.
steps: Open script.google.com, signed in to your Gmail, and press New project.
Press Project Settings (the gear) and tick Show "appsscript.json" manifest file in editor. Go back to Editor.
Open appsscript.json, select everything and paste the first box below. Open Code.gs, select everything and paste the second box. Press Save.
Pick start in the bar at the top and press Run. Press Review permissions, choose your account, then Advanced and Go to the project, and Allow. Your mail starts arriving within a minute.

files.name: Code.gs

connect.after: Google says the app is not verified because it is your own script, not one from a company. To stop it, run stop in the same project, or delete the project.
